evidence.excerpt: Adweek and Modern Retail both identify Doug Sweeny as Ōura's chief marketing officer, the marketer behind the company's first $1B year, with prior leadership roles at Levi's, Nest and One Medical. He succeeded Karina Kogan, Ōura's first CMO, who moved to an advisory role on strategic partnerships (ouraring.com/blog).

Oura Inc. filed a public Form S-1 registration statement with the SEC on 3 September 2026 (accession 0001193125-26-381855), confirming a Nasdaq listing under the ticker OURA. Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Allen & Company and Jefferies lead the offering, with a further dozen banks named including BofA Securities, Barclays and Robinhood Securities. Bloomberg reported the filing the same day; a confidential draft registration statement was submitted on 21 May 2026 (CNBC).

The S-1, as reported by Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg and the5krunner: revenue of $1.21 billion for the nine months to 30 June 2026, up 74% from $697.6 million a year earlier; $1.4 billion of trailing-twelve-month revenue and $59 million of net profit; five million paid members at 30 June 2026 against 2.5 million a year earlier; 3.6 million rings sold over the trailing twelve months, about 2% of global wearable shipments per IDC. Net loss attributable to common stockholders for the nine months was $924.3 million, reflecting a $985.0 million deemed dividend to holders of redeemable convertible preferred stock.

CNBC, 14 Oct 2025: Oura raised more than $900 million in a Series E led by Fidelity Management & Research Company at an $11 billion valuation, with new investor ICONIQ and participation from Whale Rock and Atreides. The round doubled the $5 billion valuation set at the Series D announced in December 2024. Proceeds were earmarked for production scale, international expansion and product development.

TechCrunch, 24 Aug 2026: Oura is reportedly eyeing a September IPO that could value it at more than $16 billion. Reported, not company-confirmed; the S-1 filed on 3 September does not set a price range.

LA28 newsroom and Business Wire, 6 Feb 2026: ŌURA named Official Wearable of Team USA and the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games. Ōura has also partnered with Team Finland through to the 2030 Winter Olympics.

U.S. Soccer and Business Wire, 22 Apr 2026: a long-term partnership naming Oura Ring the Official Wearable of U.S. Soccer and a Founding Partner of the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center, integrating the ring across workflows for athletes, coaches and staff across 27 national teams. Oura has supported the U.S. Women's National Team since 2020.

USTA, Aug 2026: a five-year partnership naming Oura an Official Sponsor and Wearable Fitness Device Partner of the US Open, the USTA and USTA Coaching — the USTA's first wearable partnership. Taylor Fritz and Coco Gauff joined as brand ambassadors ahead of the 2026 US Open. Sporting Goods Intelligence called it Oura's third major US sports body in six months.

MobiHealthNews: San Francisco-based Oura, founded more than a decade ago in Oulu, Finland, with offices in San Francisco and Finland and more than 900 employees, has filed a registration statement with the SEC for a proposed IPO.

Oura leadership as listed by The Org and Oura's own blog: Tom Hale, Chief Executive Officer since 1 March 2022, previously president of Momentive, which he helped take public in 2018, and before that COO of HomeAway and CPO of Linden Lab, with executive roles at Macromedia and Adobe; Sean Brecker, Chief Financial Officer; Michael A. Chapp, Chief Operating Officer since April 2019; Doug Sweeny, Chief Marketing Officer. No president is listed. No motorsport role appears in any current leader's history.

Sponsor table: on the 2026 F1 grid WHOOP has joined Scuderia Ferrari and Eight Sleep has joined Aston Martin Aramco; McLaren carries Optimum Nutrition; Oracle Red Bull Racing carries Oracle as title and TAG Heuer as a major partner, and Oura does not appear on its 2026 roster. On the Formula E grid no team carries a wearable or health-technology partner. Andretti Formula E: TWG AI as primary partner of the Formula E programme and Official Artificial Intelligence Partner of Andretti Global since 2026, plus Quest Global, Crowe UK, Reflo and TWG Motorsports ownership branding; Nissan supplies the powertrain from Season 13. Jaguar TCS Racing locks financial services with Chase; Porsche Formula E Team has TDK as official technology partner after TAG Heuer's exit.

why_now.label: The trigger
why_now.text: Oura Inc. filed a public Form S-1 with the SEC on 3 September 2026 for a Nasdaq listing under the ticker OURA. Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Allen & Company and Jefferies lead the offering, with around a dozen further banks named. Five million paid members against 2.5 million a year earlier, and 3.6 million rings sold over twelve months. The nine-month loss attributable to common stockholders of $924.3M is an accounting artefact of a $985.0M deemed dividend to preferred holders, not trading performance.

why_team.label: An empty category across a whole championship
why_team.text: The sponsor table shows no wearable, health-technology or recovery partner on any 2026 Formula E roster. On the Formula 1 grid the same lane is filling fast - WHOOP at Scuderia Ferrari, Eight Sleep at Aston Martin Aramco. Official Health Technology Partner is therefore available in Formula E as a clean, ownable designation rather than a contested one.

why_team.label: The American entry, for an American listing
why_team.text: Andretti Formula E is the US team on the grid, run under TWG Global with TWG AI as primary partner of the Formula E programme and Official Artificial Intelligence Partner of Andretti Global since 2026, alongside Quest Global, Crowe UK and Reflo. Season 13 gives it two home rounds, Austin and Miami, which is where a newly Nasdaq-listed consumer brand wants its hospitality.

why_team.label: It sits inside the portfolio Oura already owns
why_team.text: Oura is Official Wearable of Team USA and the LA28 Games and of U.S. Soccer's 27 national teams, and holds a five-year USTA agreement covering the US Open. A three-year Formula E term running to LA28 is the same audience and the same message, extended to the one arena the shelf is missing.

why_team.label: Why Formula E and not Formula 1
why_team.text: Three reasons, stated plainly. The Formula 1 human-performance lane is taken at the two teams that fit. Oura's own Formula 1 history sits at Red Bull Racing, which is not on its 2026 roster, so a return means re-opening a lapsed relationship or partnering a direct rival of it. And Formula E's price for a category-defining designation is a fraction of Formula 1's, which matters in the first budget cycle after a listing.

value.label: Operational workstream (Mode A)
value.text: Season 13 is 21 races in 13 cities on four continents between December and July. The limiting factor for drivers, race engineers and travelling crew across that schedule is sleep debt and circadian disruption, not fitness. Oura Ring gives the team's performance staff readiness, sleep-stage, heart-rate-variability and body-temperature data per person per day - the same instrumentation Oura supplies to Team USA and supplied to Red Bull Racing's drivers and pit crew from 2020.

value.label: What the team can do with it
value.text: Travel and training plans built on measured recovery rather than assumption; a documented readiness protocol for a double-header weekend; an early-warning signal on illness in a travelling party of dozens. In a cost-capped, weight-sensitive series, a partner whose product is consumed by the people rather than the car is one the team can adopt without engineering trade-offs.

value.label: Commercial and content lift
value.text: Oura brings a five-million-member consumer base and a marketing organisation that has just spent a year activating Olympic, soccer and tennis properties. For Andretti that is retail reach, a co-branded content series on human performance in motorsport, and a partner whose brand is welcome in exactly the health-and-wellness territory Formula E's audience skews toward.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Health Technology Partner designation, sidepod and race-suit placement, naming of the team's readiness programme, driver and engineer access for Oura's channels, and hospitality at the Austin E-Prix and the Miami E-Prix for Oura's retail partners and new public-market investors.

## The screen-out that was considered and rejected

**"Already an F1/FE partner"** was the live question. Oura ran an Official Health Technology
partnership with Aston Martin Red Bull Racing from November 2020. It is **not** on Red Bull
Racing's 2026 roster in the sponsor table, no renewal announcement was found, and the 2026
portfolio analyses of the team do not list it. Grid occupancy is judged only against the sponsor
table (CLAUDE.md), so Oura is not a current F1 or FE partner and the case is buildable. The lapse
is not buried: it is the second risk row on page 2, a ruled-out reason for Red Bull, and its own
paragraph on the app page.

## Honest score — what holds it back (78, not the 86 n8n recorded)

- **Brand fit 14/20.** Oura is a consumer wellness brand; motorsport is not where its buyer sits,
  and Formula E's audience is smaller than the Olympic and national-team properties it already owns.
- **Urgency 12/20.** There is no hard deadline. The listing is the moment, not a cliff, and a
  company in a live offering can defer a sponsorship decision by two quarters at no cost.
- **Ops fit 15/20.** The workstream is real but it is a people programme, not a car programme; it
  will never be worth Formula 1 money and it is easy for a team to accept in kind.
- **On-camera 3/4.** A ring is a small logo. The value is the designation and the content, not the
  livery.
